subject: Post-demo: Proposed trial charter + activation checklist for RavenWare
message_1_subject: Post-demo: Proposed trial charter + activation checklist for RavenWare
message_1_body:
Hi Olivia / Marco,

Thanks for taking the time today — great discussion. As promised, attached is a concise trial charter and an activation checklist to get RavenWare onto Redwood Dedicated for a 6-week evaluation. Below is a distilled summary and the asks we need to lock in to start: 

Success criteria (what we’ll measure):
- Retrieval accuracy: Fresh-product FAQ answer correctness >= 85% on our agreed prompt set (see attachment).
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 300ms for 512-token chats under the planned concurrency profile.
- Cost/throughput: Sustained throughput supporting 150 concurrent sessions with <10% degradation from baseline.

Proposed timeline (weeks):
- Week 0: Contract + SOW signature, access & IP allowlist, baseline data exchange.
- Week 1: Environment provisioning, model selection & quantization profile, integration smoke tests.
- Week 2–4: Trial ramp (pilot queries, KV/prefix caching enabled), weekly checkpoints.
- Week 5: Acceptance runbook (finalized prompts, regression checks).
- Week 6: Wrap / decision + optional extension.

Ownership (what to expect from each side):
- RavenWare: Olivia (Product) — test data, acceptance decision; Marco (Infra) — network/K8s support, firewall rules.
- Redwood: Jordan (AE) — program lead; Marissa (CSM) — trial ops/contact; Ben (SE) — integration & performance tuning.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm the success criteria above (or flag edits) by EOD Friday so we can finalize the charter.
2) Confirm target kickoff week (proposed week of Sep 21).
3) Provide a single technical contact for network access (we need an IP allowlist).
4) Sign the attached short SOW (one-page) or confirm procurement timeline.

Attachments: 20260910-ravenware-trial-charter.pdf (trial charter) and ravenware-success-metrics.xlsx (prompt set & measurement matrix).

If that looks good I’ll circulate a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff and we’ll allocate Ben for an initial integration call.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

-----

message_2_subject: Re: Post-demo: Proposed trial charter + activation checklist for RavenWare
message_2_body:
Jordan — thanks, this is very clear and helpful. A few quick notes after syncing with Marco: 

- The success criteria read reasonable; we’ll confirm the prompt set once Marco validates data sensitivity.
- A quick question on retention: what’s Redwood’s default KV / prefix caching retention for trials? We need to ensure no customer prompts are persisted longer than 30 days.
- Regarding throughput: 150 concurrent sessions is on the higher side for our initial run. Could we start at 100 concurrency and ramp to 150 by Week 3 if all goes well?

We’re inclined to start the week of Sep 21 but need to check procurement approvals for the signed SOW. Please confirm the IP allowlist window and who on your side will raise the network request.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — can we lock the kickoff for Tue, Sep 22 10:00am PT as a tentative slot? If procurement is delayed we may need to push by one week.

Best,
Olivia Park
VP Product, RavenWare
olivia.park@ravenware.com | (617) 555-9987

message_3_subject: Re: Post-demo: Proposed trial charter + activation checklist for RavenWare
message_3_body:
Hi Olivia / team — quick clarifications from CS/ops side: 

- Data retention: For Dedicated trials we default to in-memory KV caching with a 14-day TTL unless customers request otherwise. We can explicitly set KV/prefix cache TTL to 30 days for RavenWare and add a note in the SOW. We don’t persist raw prompts to disk outside of logs retained per your policy.
- Throughput ramp: Starting at 100 concurrency with a planned ramp to 150 by Week 3 is fine — Ben, can you prepare a short runbook for ramp steps and expected token-rate vs cost impact?
- IP allowlist: Jordan — please send RavenWare the outbound IP range and the minimal firewall ports (TLS 443 + gRPC port) we’ll need. Marco, once we have the IPs we can provision temporary VPN keys if needed.
- Procurement / SOW: I’ll start the SOW routing on our side. Olivia — what is the internal PO timing? If you expect >10 business days we should start the SOW signature earlier and consider a soft-start that only requires an NDA+short SOW.

I’ll also add a brief acceptance checklist to the charter (smoke pass, 95th pctl latency run, and docs for regression gaps).

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

message_4_subject: Re: Post-demo: Proposed trial charter + activation checklist for RavenWare
message_4_body:
Olivia / Marco — thanks for the quick responses. We’ll proceed with the adjusted plan: 

1) Success criteria: accept as written. Marissa will set KV TTL to 30 days and add the explicit note in the SOW.
2) Concurrency ramp: start at 100, target 150 by end of Week 3 (Ben will own the ramp runbook).
3) Kickoff: tentatively Tue, Sep 22 10:00am PT. I’ll send the calendar invite now — please accept or propose an alternative.
4) IP allowlist: outbound IP range and required ports are included in the attached one-pager; Marco, reply with the single tech contact and we’ll open the allowlist window.
5) SOW & procurement: Olivia — if PO timing looks like >7 business days we can accept a countersigned one-page SOW + NDA to begin provisioning while the PO completes. Please let us know preference by Sep 17.

I’ve attached a slightly revised charter that includes the acceptance checklist and the ramp plan. Next actions for RavenWare: confirm kickoff slot, provide tech contact, and confirm SOW path.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
